# Auto UUID for Strapi 5

> Auto UUID (npm: strapi-auto-uuid-v5, plugin id: field-uuid) is a free, MIT-licensed Strapi 5 plugin that adds a UUID v4 or v7 custom field. The server generates the value when an entry is created, keeps it unique across documents, locales and draft/published versions, and locks it unless editing is allowed. An admin page checks, repairs, exports and imports UUIDs.

The current version is on npm (link below). It is the Strapi 5 continuation of Cringe-Studio/strapi-auto-uuid, which supports Strapi 4 only.

What it does:

- Custom field `plugin::field-uuid.uuid` with UUID v4 (random) or v7 (time-sortable) and an optional prefix of 1 to 16 letters, numbers, `_` or `-` (for example `usr_`).
- Values are generated on the server for every write path: admin, REST, GraphQL and the Document Service.
- Uniqueness is checked on every save, case-insensitively (RFC 9562); new values are stored in lowercase. There is no database unique constraint; concurrent saves are serialized with database locks.
- Values are locked by default; the field options "Allow manual editing" and "Disable auto-generation" change that per field.
- UUID fields inside components and dynamic zones are filled only by the admin panel; the server does not generate, validate or repair them.
- Safe with several Strapi processes on one database (Railway replicas, pm2 cluster); no Redis.
- No outbound network calls, no telemetry, no license key. Admin UI in English, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese.

Requirements:

- Strapi `^5.24.0` (Strapi 4: use Cringe-Studio/strapi-auto-uuid)
- Node.js `>=22.12.0 <=26.x.x`
- SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL 8 / MariaDB

Install:

```bash
npm install strapi-auto-uuid-v5
```

```ts
// config/plugins.ts
export default () => ({
  'field-uuid': {
    enabled: true,
  },
});
```

Then rebuild the admin, add a UUID field in the Content-Type Builder and save an entry.

Configuration essentials:

- Plugin config keys (all optional, validated at boot): `defaultVersion` (`'v4'` | `'v7'`, default `'v4'`), `autoGenerate` (default `true`), `validateUniqueness` (default `true`), `maxRetryAttempts` (1 to 10, default `3`), `autoMigrate` (default `false`), `logLevel` (default `'info'`), `rateLimitStore` (`'auto'` | `'database'` | `'memory'`).
- `STRAPI_AUTO_UUID_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_MIGRATE=true` lets `autoMigrate` run when `NODE_ENV=production`.
- Admin permissions: `plugin::field-uuid.read`, `migrate`, `export`, `import`. The plugin adds no Content API permissions.
